title: Fusion-pM iScience reproducibility release v1.0.4
description: Fusion-pM is a cross-attention Transformer for Class I HLA-peptide binding prediction. This release provides five pretrained checkpoints, inference scripts, a reproducible benchmark workflow, frozen input provenance, exact baseline source cells, and training-overlap analyses for the iScience revision.
